description: This file defines the tlAttachmentRepository class, which manages storage, retrieval, and deletion of file attachments in the TestLink project. It includes methods for handling filesystem and database repositories, attachment operations, and configuration management.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: Class for managing storage, retrieval, and deletion of attachments, supporting filesystem and database repositories, with capabilities for linking attachments to database objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing repository settings and attachment object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the singleton instance of tlAttachmentRepository.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the repository type (filesystem or database).

methods.name: getCompression
methods.description: Returns the compression type used in the repository.

methods.name: getPathToRepository
methods.description: Returns the path to the filesystem repository.

methods.name: insertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts attachment into repository and database, handling file storage and metadata.

methods.name: buildRepositoryFilePath
methods.description: Builds a full path for storing a file based on table information and filename.

methods.name: getFileContentsForDBRepository
methods.description: Reads file content, optionally compressing it for database storage.

methods.name: storeFileInFSRepository
methods.description: Stores a uploaded or local file into the filesystem repository.

methods.name: buildRepositoryFolderFor
methods.description: Builds folder path for attachments, creating directories if specified.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes an attachment, removing file and database entries.

methods.name: getAttachmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves content of attachment, from filesystem or database depending on repository type.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for attachment by ID.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfosFor
methods.description: Retrieves all attachments linked to a specific object.

methods.name: getAttachmentIDsFor
methods.description: Yields attachment IDs for a specific object.

methods.name: copyAttachments
methods.description: Copies attachments from one object to another, handling file copying and database updates.
